pattern: Native radios sharing one name inside <fieldset role="radiogroup"> + <legend> (WAI-ARIA APG Radio Group, native keyboard model).

roles.role: radiogroup (explicit), named by the legend via aria-labelledby

aria.value: "true" only while an error message is shown
Group help text and visible error message ids
That option's help text id, when present

keyboard.action: Moves focus into the group (selected radio, else the first enabled radio) and out of it; the group is one tab stop.
Moves to and selects the next enabled radio, wrapping (native).
Moves to and selects the previous enabled radio, wrapping (native).

focus: The native radio is the focus target and shows a color-focus-ring outline on :focus-visible.
notes: The required asterisk is aria-hidden; aria-required on the radiogroup and native required on the radios convey the state.
Selection is shown by an inner dot, not only by the fill color.
Arrow-key navigation is native: disabled radios are skipped and selection follows focus.
Errors appear after focus leaves the group by default, not when moving between radios.
knownCaveats: Screen-reader announcement of aria-invalid and aria-describedby on the radiogroup has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
